title: Share of the Final Month Amortized under an Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
**Counting the days.** For a terminated **Entrance Fee Agreement**, the days the agreement ran into its final month are counted on a thirty-day-month convention, from the first day of the last month already amortized: thirty days are deducted from the calendar days between that day and the end date of the count. The first day of the last month already amortized is the posting date of the latest amortization entry on the agreement's ledger. The days counted never fall below 0.

**Share.** The share of the final month amortized follows the days the agreement ran into it: 10 days or fewer are amortized pro rata at that number of days over 30, 11 to 20 days are amortized at one half of the month, and more than 20 days are amortized as a full month.

**Where the share acts.** The share is applied to the product of the month's percentage and the entrance fee, before the cap at the refundable balance above the floor and before the single rounding to the cent.

## Share ladder

| Days run into the final month | Share of the month |
|---|---|
| 10 or fewer | That number of days over 30 |
| 11 to 20 | 0.5 |
| More than 20 | 1 (full month) |

## Boundaries

| Days | Share |
|---|---|
| 10 | 10 over 30 |
| 11 | 0.5 |
| 20 | 0.5 |
| 21 | 1 |
| 0 | 0 |

## Hypothetical counts (last month already amortized began 10 May)

| End date of the count | Calendar days from 10 May | Less 30 | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18 June | 39 | 9 | 9 over 30 |
| 25 June | 46 | 16 | 0.5 |
| 5 July | 56 | 26 | 1 |

With a hypothetical month amount of 5113.50 before the share, 9 days give 5113.50 multiplied by 9 and divided by 30, that is 1534.05, before any cap and the rounding.
